title: CircleCI Workflow
description: A CircleCI workflow organizes a set of jobs and defines the order, dependencies, and conditions under which they run within a pipeline.

pipeline_id.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline this workflow belongs to

id.description: The unique identifier of the workflow

name.description: The name of the workflow as defined in the CircleCI configuration

project_slug.description: The project slug in vcs-slug/org-name/repo-name format

status.description: The current status of the workflow

started_by.description: The ID of the user who started the workflow

stopped_at.description: When the workflow stopped, null if still running

tag.description: Tag for special workflow types like setup workflows
